title: cymbopogon flexuosus var. microstachys
intro: Cymbopogon flexuosus var. microstachys, commonly known as East Indian lemongrass, is a plant species belonging to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which help to alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and treat respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of East Indian lemongrass include its ability to calm the mind, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in aromatherapy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include citral, limonene, and beta-pinene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in the production of essential oils.
